entities.summary: Yuriko Ishida is a Japanese actress and essayist from Nagoya. She was the Japanese voice of the title character San from the 1997 animated film Princess Mononoke. She is the older sister of Hikari Ishida, also an actress. Yuriko Ishida was a performers & entertainers from Nagoya (b. 1969-10-03, Nagoya). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
